title: Constructible flat models for Noetherian coefficient rings
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, put $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]), and let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian $\Lambda$-algebra. Work in the ordinary derived categories of module sheaves on the small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For a commutative ring $R$, write $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for complexes with bounded cohomology admitting a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] on each stratum of which (after restriction) each cohomology sheaf is locally constant of finite type [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules], i.e. locally constant with finitely generated $R$-module stalks [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; for $R=\Lambda$ this is [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Write $D^b_{ctf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for the full subcategory of these objects $P$ for which there are integers $a\le b$ such that $P\otimes^L_{R_X}F$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ for every $R_X$-module sheaf $F$ in degree zero, using the constant coefficient sheaf and derived tensor of [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of Tor amplitude $[a,b]$, there is a representing cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] $F^\bullet$ with $F^q=0$ outside $[a,b]$ and each $F^q$ flat and constructible. Flat means that tensoring module sheaves with $F^q$ is exact. Moreover there is a finite locally closed stratification by connected reduced subschemes $S_i$ and connected finite etale Galois covers $V_i\to S_i$ on which all the nonzero terms $F^q|_{S_i}$ become constant with finitely generated projective $A$-module values (direct summands of finite free modules). Galois here means a cover with a finite group acting simply transitively on each geometric fibre. The empty scheme is allowed.

source.place: Tag 03TT, lemma-when-ctf, and the following remark-projective-each-degree; simultaneous Galois trivialization after stratification as in ILO XVII 7.3.1 and the proof of 7.6.1, p. 314.

proof.text: Let $T$ be the class of constructible $A_X$-module sheaves and $S$ its subclass of flat sheaves. Apply [lem-sfb-discrete-noetherian-constructible-serre] on the small etale site: $T$ contains zero, is invariant under isomorphisms, and is closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions. Its local finite-presentation convention agrees with the finite-type convention here: over the Noetherian ring $A$, a finite generating surjection $A^n\to M$ has finitely generated kernel by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-submodule-finite], and hence gives a finite presentation. To compare the local and global partition conventions, choose the finite affine cover $X=\bigcup_{i=1}^r U_i$ in the hypothesis and put $W_i=U_i\setminus\bigcup_{j<i}U_j$. These are disjoint locally closed subschemes covering $X$. Intersect $W_i$ with each stratum of the finite partition on $U_i$. The resulting finite collection of locally closed pieces is a global partition with the same local module values. Conversely a global partition restricts to one on every affine open.

source.place: Tag 03RZ, lemma-constructible-abelian (3); Noetherian coefficient convention in section-ctf

proof.text: The class $S$ contains zero and is invariant under isomorphisms. If $E,E\prime$ are in $S$, their biproduct is constructible since $0\to E\to E\oplus E\prime\to E\prime\to0$ is an extension of constructibles. Its tensor functor is the direct sum of the exact tensor functors of $E$ and $E\prime$, and is exact; thus $S$ is closed under binary biproducts. Every $S$-object is, by definition, flat and in $T$. Finally [lem-per-noetherian-constructible-flat-lifting], with $R=A$, gives precisely lifting of epimorphisms onto $T$ by objects of $S$: for $p:B\twoheadrightarrow C$ and $g:G\to C$, it supplies $E\in S$, $e:E\twoheadrightarrow G$, and $h:E\to B$ with $ph=ge$.

source.place: Tag 03TT, proof, affine-free covers lifting through an epimorphism; class hypotheses written out

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-flat-model-class-resolution] to these $S,T$ in the category of $A_X$-module sheaves. Its cohomology hypothesis holds because $K\in D^b_c$, and its Tor-vanishing hypothesis is exactly the specified amplitude $[a,b]$ against every degree-zero module sheaf. The class hypotheses were verified in Steps 1 and 2. We obtain a complex $F^\bullet$ representing $K$, zero outside $[a,b]$, with every term flat and in $T$. This uses the bounded-above lifting-class resolution followed by the cokernel truncation at $a$; it does not assert that flat sheaves are projective objects of the sheaf category.

source.place: exists_iso_Q_obj_flat_of_torAmplitudeIn_of_liftsAlongEpi, lines 72-124 (declaration at 72); generic lifting-class refinement of Stacks 08CI

proof.text: Only the finitely many degrees $a\le q\le b$ occur. Apply [lem-per-noetherian-constructible-galois-partition] to the family $(F^q)_{a\le q\le b}$. It supplies one finite stratification by connected reduced $S_i$, one connected finite etale Galois cover $V_i\to S_i$ for each stratum, and finitely presented $A$-modules $M_{iq}$ with $F^q$ constant of value $M_{iq}$ after this restriction. Thus the covers are simultaneous for every term, without requiring simultaneous trivialization of infinitely many terms.

source.place: Tags 095N and 03S0, finite presentations and simultaneous stratification; ILO XVII 7.3.1 and proof of 7.6.1, p. 314

proof.text: Fix $i,q$ and put $H=c_i^{-1}(F^q|_{S_i})$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-flat-module-pullback] to the two restriction morphisms of constant-$A$ ringed topoi: $H$ is flat on $V_i$. Choose a geometric point $v$ of the nonempty scheme $V_i$. Apply the same node to the point morphism $(\mathbf{Set},A)\to(V_{i,\mathrm{et}},A_{V_i})$: $H_v$ is a flat $A$-module. By Step 4, $H$ is the constant module sheaf of value $M_{iq}$. The constant-sheaf stalk identification [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-geometric-stalk] gives $M_{iq}\cong H_v$. It is $A$-linear: for each scalar $r$, the germ map carries a constant section $rm$ to $r$ times the germ of $m$. Thus $M_{iq}$ is flat and, by Step 4, finitely presented. Now [lem-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-flat-module-projective] makes it finite projective. Explicitly, choose a finite generating epimorphism $A^n\twoheadrightarrow M_{iq}$. Projectivity lifts its identity to a section, so $A^n\cong M_{iq}\oplus\ker(A^n\to M_{iq})$, giving the required direct summand.

source.place: Tag 05VD, lemma-pullback-flat, applied to restrictions and a point; etale-cohomology.tex remark-projective-each-degree after Tag 03TT; algebra.tex Tag 00NX, lemma-finite-projective

proof.text: If $X$ is empty, take the zero complex and the empty stratification. Every module sheaf on the empty scheme is zero (the sheaf axiom for the empty covering forces its sections to be the zero module), hence every derived object is zero and this complex represents $K$. All term and stratum conditions are vacuous. A zero term in the nonempty case has value the zero projective module.

source.place: Tag 03TT, amplitude-zero base case and the empty-scheme convention

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q59-904d92dfe (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item, both new nodes and every cited node in full. Sources: Stacks 03TT with its proof and remark-projective-each-degree, 095N, 03S0, 03S8(3) and 03SF (pione.tex); ILO XVII Def 7.3.1, Lemma 7.6.11 and the proof of 7.6.1 (pp. 303, 313-314). The item statement is unchanged and matches 03TT plus the ILO Galois partition, with no l-invertibility needed. Step 1: the Noetherian constructible Serre node gives closure under kernels, cokernels and extensions; the affine-local partitions are converted to a global one by disjointing the affine cover, and finite type to finite presentation by the Mathlib leaf. Step 2: biproduct closure and the lifting square are exactly the flat-lifting node with R=A. Step 3: every hypothesis of lem-sf-flat-model-class-resolution is verified; the node is Lean-closed and has no finite-ring hypothesis. Step 4: the Galois-partition node is applied to the finite family of terms. Step 5: flat pullback to a point and the constant stalk give flat finitely presented values, hence projective by 00NX; V_i is nonempty because it is connected. Step 6: the empty case is elementary. New nodes, both true and statement-only. Flat-lifting follows the 095N affine-free quotient argument (local lifts refined to finitely many affines, flat by free stalks, constructible by 03S8(3)). Galois-partition holds for any Noetherian X: a finite affine trivializing cover, 03S0 to make it finite etale on strata, connected components, then the Galois closure. Stratifying is necessary because infinite monodromy is possible on a nodal curve with A=F_l[t], and the node allows it. Neither node restates a clause of the item. Not duplicates: lem-sf-etale-flat-constructible-lifting needs finite Lambda, which the new node generalizes; lem-per-constructible-finite-monodromy-filtration trivializes only the graded pieces of a filtration. B1-B9 hold and all three kinds of search are recorded. The declared tool_uses are accepted as generic black boxes. No SGA, no cycle. Maintainer notes: lem-sf-etale-flat-constructible-lifting could cite the new flat-lifting node when split; the Galois-partition node's source.document says etale-cohomology.tex while its place names pione.tex for 03SF (cosmetic).

lean.statement: theorem exists_noetherian_ctf_flat_model (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra (ZMod l) A] (a b : ℤ) (_hab : a ≤ b) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (_hK : DerivedCategory.boundedConstructible (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X K) (_hTor : DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn A X a b K) : ∃ F : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ, Nonempty ((_root_.DerivedCategory.Q).obj F ≅ K) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) → IsZero (F.X q)) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (F.X q) ∧ Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf (F.X q)) ∧ ∃ S : Scheme.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X, (∀ i : Fin S.n, IsReduced (S.domain i)) ∧ ∀ i : Fin S.n, ∃ hS : ConnectedSpace (S.domain i), ∃ V : (S.domain i).FiniteEtale, @PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois _ _ (@Scheme.FiniteEtale.galoisCategory (S.domain i) hS) V ∧ ConnectedSpace V.obj.left ∧ ∀ q : ℤ, a ≤ q → q ≤ b → ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A, Module.Finite A M ∧ Module.Projective A M ∧ Nonempty ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (V.obj.hom ≫ S.immersion i)).obj (F.X q) ≅ (constantSheaf V.obj.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).obj M)
